row.title: The reference vault seals values under a deploy-held key (US-30-R53)
row.body: Given a key option (32 bytes, base64, bound by the deploy and absent from D1), createVault encrypts each stored secret with AES-GCM and uses the secret's name as additional data, so a ciphertext copied to another row will not decrypt. Rows written before a key existed stay readable and are encrypted at their first read or write; legacy: false refuses unencrypted rows outright, and has() answers what read() can use. No key is wired in at the composition root yet. Proven by node --test workers/core/vault/*.test.js.
